name: hizuri
description: A self-learning agent: memory of every session searched before it asks you, a Guardian side check against its rules whose notes the agent must answer, a dated retro line on every complaint, a weekly retro it runs alone, skills it writes and has reviewed, the hizuri daemon's tools, and secrets typed from your own vault.

language.title: Language of notes
language.description: The language the Guardian writes its notes in (rule keys stay English).

guardianModel.title: Guardian model
guardianModel.description: Model alias or id for the Guardian side check. A small model is enough and costs little.

guardianEvery.title: Guardian: check every N steps
guardianEvery.description: The Guardian checks once this many model requests have passed since its last check, at each trigger moment and once at each turn end.

guardianBlocks.title: Guardian: rules that refuse a reply
guardianBlocks.description: Comma-separated rule keys whose sure misses refuse the reply itself instead of a note (memory-first, check-dont-guess). Empty: notes only.
